## 2026-09-15

### Impact

This update is recommended for apps that include Swift 5-built dependencies. It prevents a potential crash during WebKit operations in mixed Swift configurations and fixes login-page buttons being obscured by the toolbar on iOS 26+.

### Changes

- Fixes an issue that hid the bottom button on some login pages below the toolbar on iOS 26+
- Fixes a crash caused by conflicting compiler-generated Objective-C async bridge symbols when MuppetIOS is linked alongside code built with the Swift 5 language mode.

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

| Name  | Version |
| ----- | ------- |
| Xcode | >= 26.1 |
| iOS   | >= 15.0 |
